mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, supporting higher equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS threshold is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, it indicates stagflation risk, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 230.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the market is oversold and pricing in a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 is above its 5-year moving average or the Rank IC for GDPC1 is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650.0, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 650.0) or the Rank IC for HOUST threshold is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 95.0 and residential sales (RSAFS) rise above 400000.0, it indicates a shift in economic activity towards services, which is less sensitive to interest rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuations and reduce risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising) or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
